final_message:
I fixed `wrap` in `src/wrap.py`. `wrap('aaa bbb ccc', 7)` now returns `['aaa bbb', 'ccc']`, and the 5 existing tests pass.

The cause was an off-by-one in the line-length check. It compared against `width - 1`, so a line that was exactly `width` characters long was treated as too long. I changed it to compare against `width`.

I didn't add a regression test for this case.
